snippet.title: First 30 Minutes: Cabela's Big Game Hunter 2012 [XBOX360/PS3/WII]
snippet.description:
Buy this game (Amazon): http://amzn.to/BigGameHunter2012 

First 30 minutes of gameplay from the new hunting simulation Cabela's Big Game Hunter 2012

My first 30 minute videos are a series of videos that feature the first 30 minutes of unedited gameplay from new and old video games

DISCLAIMER: This video is intended for educational purposes on how to play the game

Recorded on the Xbox 360 version

Twitter: http://twitter.com/First30Minutes

Ever wondered how I record game footage? Check this out: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OaD41WhpcDw
